```{python}
m = data.plugin_maintenance().iloc[-1]
c = data.contributors_by_year()
year = int(c["year"].max())
contributors = int(c.loc[c["year"] == year, "contributors"].sum())
d = data.pypi_downloads().tail(12)["downloads"].sum()
recent = data.plugin_maintenance().query("month >= '2022-01-01'")["active_plugins"]
lo, hi = int(recent.min()), int(recent.max())
```

The plugin count keeps climbing; the number of plugins that still get releases has
stayed between `{python} lo` and `{python} hi` since 2022.
